name: sfx.search
title: Search recorded sound effects (any library provider)
summary: Search a sound library (freesound, or one an extension adds) for recorded sound effects and ambiences, and get candidates with their length, licence, author and a preview link, the same fields whichever library answers.
description: Submit {"tool": "sfx.search", "input": {"provider": "freesound", "query": "rain on a tent"}} and the service runs the provider's own tool with the rest of the input. Every provider takes the fields below with the same meaning and may take its own (sorting, raw filters). Pick sounds from the result and bring them in with the sfx.fetch contract, which converts them to WAV, measures them and keeps their credits. Licences differ per sound: read `license` before using one, and keep the attribution a licence asks for.
outputs: No files: the result lists the candidates.

provider.description: Which library to search: freesound (Freesound, needs its API key), or a provider an extension adds. GET /v1/contracts/sfx.search lists them and whether each can run here.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, for example "wooden door creak" or "small classroom murmur".

limit.description: How many candidates to return at most. Providers apply their own default.

min_seconds.description: Keep only sounds at least this long. Omit for no lower bound.

max_seconds.description: Keep only sounds at most this long. Omit for no upper bound.

licenses.description: Keep only sounds under these licences, as short codes: cc0 (public domain), by (attribution), by-nc (attribution, non-commercial), sampling+ (Creative Commons Sampling Plus). Omit to see every licence the library has.

sounds.description: The candidates, in the provider's order (best match first unless a sort was asked for).

id.description: The sound's id in the library; pass it to sfx.fetch.

name.description: The sound's title in the library.

license.description: Licence code: cc0, by, by-nc, sampling+ or other (see license_url).

license_url.description: The licence's own link, when the library gives one.

author.description: Who uploaded or recorded it, as the library names them.

url.description: The sound's page in the library.

tags.description: The library's tags, when it has them.

preview.description: A link to a preview a human can play, when the library has one.

total.description: How many sounds match in the whole library, when the provider knows.

warnings.description: Anything worth knowing about the search, e.g. a filter the library could not apply.
